about: What was tested for the Portable Raman controller, catalog edition, and how. Everything ran on one Mac, in simulation, with the local demo catalog, with three exceptions on 2026-11-16: the two live uploads of 'live_uploads_to_arc' reached Globus and ARC, and an ssh session moved one of them by hand on ARC, all signed in by the user; and the user started run_hardware.sh once, with no instrument attached. Entries set to false in 'verified' were not tested at all. Every run and count recorded here, except those under 'after_removing_the_catalog_service', was made before 2026-11-17. On that day the connection to an external catalog service (a second catalog the edition had and never used), the cluster job that depended on it, the holding back of simulated captures that only that service's mode did, and their tests were taken out of the code. The entries that were only about those parts were removed from this file; the counts of the earlier runs include tests that no longer exist.

after_removing_the_catalog_service.what_changed: Taken out of the code: the second catalog (an external catalog service), its settings (the mode key and the context, repository and include_simulated keys; the root alias is catalog.root_alias now), the holding back of simulated captures, the checks of doctor that were about that service (doctor now checks the Python version and the settings and answers 'ready'), the cluster classification job with its batch script and folder data_layer/arc/, and the tests of all these. The folder, the Python package and the settings file were renamed (Portable_Raman_Catalog, raman_catalog, catalog_config.json, catalog_python.txt, RAMAN_CATALOG_PYTHON).

test_suites.after_review_fixes: The first four full runs above were made before the review fixes of 2026-11-13, the fifth and sixth after the first round of them (the sixth after the dark's .json got its own schema id). A second round of review fixes followed on 2026-11-14, and after it the hand-over changes of the documentation step. The seventh run, made after both, was the last full run before the uploads to ARC; before it, each suite they changed had passed when run on its own. On 2026-11-15 the uploads to ARC were added: three full runs followed (the eighth with the four parts merged, the ninth after the integration's changes, the tenth after its last changes). Later on 2026-11-15 six reviews with skeptics checked the uploads to ARC (88 findings: 6 high, 8 medium, about 60 low, 14 info); every finding was fixed or explained by six fixers and the integration. The eleventh run followed their changes; a run started after it was stopped by hand once its build was done, so that five tests could be added first; the twelfth run was made after every change. A check of the twelfth run's state found 4 regressions and 4 findings fixed only in part; a second round of fixes followed, and the thirteenth run was made after it. After that run only the run's counts and its smoke test were written into README.md, macos-native/README.md and this file, and the data layer's suite, which reads the READMEs, passed again (1143 tests OK). A check of the thirteenth run's state found 6 more small defects (5 low, 1 info), and one finding was still fixed only in part; a third round of fixes followed on 2026-11-16, and the fourteenth run was made after it. After that run, too, only the run's counts and its smoke test were written into README.md, macos-native/README.md and this file, and the data layer's suite passed again (1155 tests OK). A check of the fourteenth run's state found 4 more small points (3 low, 1 info); a fourth round of fixes followed on 2026-11-16, and the fifteenth run was made after it. After that run arc_ui_tests ran 5 times in a row. Then only documentation changed: the run's counts and the round's checks went into this file, the counts into macos-native/README.md, and a line on how the round was checked into README.md section 13; the data layer's suite, which reads the READMEs, passed again (1162 tests OK).
